mprTitleBlockFill.Description: Fills sheet title blocks using configurable profiles: signers, dates, signatures and other fields
mprTitleBlockFill.t6: Field to take the value from
mprTitleBlockFill.t12: Group name, for example Designed by
mprTitleBlockFill.t15: Check the sheets selected in the Project Browser and the current sheet
mprTitleBlockFill.t16: Signature file name. The signature is placed if a name is entered
mprTitleBlockFill.t18: No signature file with this name was found in the signatures folder
mprTitleBlockFill.t20: Show which values will change before writing
mprTitleBlockFill.t21: Clear the fields of the checked rows on the selected sheets
mprTitleBlockFill.t22: Parameter owner The element on which the plugin looks for the parameter
mprTitleBlockFill.t26: Field type How the value is entered and written
mprTitleBlockFill.t27: Value source Where the field value comes from
mprTitleBlockFill.t28: Parameter The field value is written to it
mprTitleBlockFill.t29: Constant value Written on every fill
mprTitleBlockFill.t30: Constant check box value Written on every fill
mprTitleBlockFill.t31: Source field Its value is also written to this field
mprTitleBlockFill.t33: The value is collected separately for each sheet from the views placed on it, in the order of their detail numbers. Repeated names are written once. The field is not shown when filling
mprTitleBlockFill.t35: Format for writing the date to a text parameter. dd - day, MM - month, yy or yyyy - year. Lowercase mm means minutes, not month. In a "Yes/No" parameter the date is written as a check mark
mprTitleBlockFill.t36: Signature method How the signature gets into the title block
mprTitleBlockFill.t37: Placeholder family Placed when the signature is removed
mprTitleBlockFill.t38: Text in title block family: the plugin writes the signature name to a text parameter, and the family itself shows the signature. Family from signatures folder: an instance parameter of the "Family Type" data type, the signature file is loaded from the folder; a placeholder family is needed to remove a signature. The signature file name is the field value, for example from the name field
mprTitleBlockFill.t39: If unchecked, empty text, a cleared check box and a cleared signature mark are skipped and do not overwrite what is already filled in the title block. If checked, the text is cleared, the check box is cleared and the signature is removed
mprTitleBlockFill.t40: Add or import a title block profile
mprTitleBlockFill.t41: Check the document types to which the profile applies
mprTitleBlockFill.t42: The fields filled by the plugin are organized into groups. Fields of one group are filled together and enabled with one check mark. The order of groups and fields is the order in the fill window
mprTitleBlockFill.t43: There are issues in the settings of the group or its fields
mprTitleBlockFill.t44: Group name Block header when filling
mprTitleBlockFill.t47: Sheets are grouped in the fill section by the value of this parameter, for example by project section
mprTitleBlockFill.t49: Needed only for the "Family from signatures folder" signature method: signature families and the "no signature" placeholder family are loaded from this folder. The family file name is the signature name, for example J.Smith.rfa. The folder is not used by the "Text in title block family" method
